title: Alliterative Name · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Alliterative Name · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a common first name. The lead invents a friendly two-word nickname whose words start with the same sound. The two words have the agreed initial sound and form an understandable nickname. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Alliterative Name, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The two words have the agreed initial sound and form an understandable nickname.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The two words have the agreed initial sound and form an understandable nickname.
